stem: This satirical cartoon expresses a sentiment that eventually contributed to —

options.label: A
options.text: the passage of a federal statute prohibiting foreign companies from contributing to presidential campaigns

options.label: B
options.text: the issuance of a Supreme Court ruling declaring it unconstitutional for members of the same political party to serve consecutive terms as president

options.label: C
options.text: the establishment of a congressional committee to investigate private presidential conduct

options.label: D
options.text: the ratification of a constitutional amendment establishing term limits for presidents

visual_elements: Four sealed-panel political cartoon depicting a man in 1932 and 1936 saying 'MY FRIENDS!' and then in 1940 and 1944 depicted as a king saying 'MY SUBJECTS!' and 'MY SLAVES!'
